title: FlowForge — Operations
description: Throughput, latency, backlog, errors, maintenance and process health of the FlowForge API (ADR-017).

panels.title: API instances up
panels.description: Instances Prometheus can scrape. 0 means the API (or its metrics listener) is down.

panels.title: Redis
panels.description: Wake-ups go through Redis; when degraded, workers fall back to polling and nothing is lost.

panels.title: DB pool in use
panels.description: Connection permits in use across instances.

panels.title: Queued tasks
panels.description: Tasks waiting for a worker (sampled from Postgres).

panels.title: Oldest queued task
panels.description: How long the longest-waiting task has been queued.

panels.title: Loop errors (15 min)
panels.description: Failed maintenance, relay or retention ticks.

panels.title: Runs finished per second, by final state
Task attempts per second, by outcome
panels.description: lease_expired: worker crashed or partitioned. timed_out: attempt exceeded its timeout.

panels.title: Queue wait (queued to leased)
panels.description: Rising queue wait with idle workers points at capabilities, quotas or concurrency limits.

panels.title: API latency, all routes except the worker long-poll
panels.description: Per-route latency: Explore with sum by (le, route). The long-poll is excluded because it waits by design.

panels.title: Backlog and capacity (sampled from Postgres; max across instances)
Outbox: oldest unrelayed row
panels.description: Wake-up delay. Grows while Redis is down; workers still poll, so this delays work, it does not lose it.

panels.title: State sample age
panels.description: If this grows, the gauges in this row are stale (the sampler cannot reach Postgres).

panels.title: Server errors per second, by code
panels.description: database_* are 503s: the database is slow or unreachable. internal is a bug: find it in the logs by trace_id.

panels.title: Quota rejections per second, by quota
Other client errors per second
panels.description: 4xx answers other than refusals (validation, auth, not found, lease_lost). Explore by code for detail.

panels.title: Background loop duration p95, by loop
Maintenance rows per second, by action
Retention: rows deleted per hour, by category
Event loop lag p99, by instance
Engine clock: database minus host
panels.description: Engine time follows the database clock (ADR-015). This is how far each host's own clock is from it; the engine is unaffected.
